The UN Olympics is an event hosted by the biggest clan in Openfront, United Nations. There were 3 events covered, 1v1s, FFA and Trios.

About

Format

  • General Information
    • Free registration
    • 6 games
    • 25 minute timer
    • Placement: player with the crown at the end of the 25 minutes wins, then the top 4 remaing players with the maximum percentage land owned at any given point in the game

Map Rotation

The following 6 maps were played in this exact rotation:

  • Europe
  • World
  • North America
  • Africa
  • San Francisco
  • Mena

Final Results

Scored by game winner, then top 6 by maximum percentage land owned at any given point in the game. Positions beyond 6th are all ranked as 10th. Tiebreakers by most wins, then most appearances in top 6, and lastly higher total percentage territory across all games.
